prayerExcerpt.en-US: Never was novice more fervent, more unrelaxing in his efforts for self-mastery.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Nunca houve noviço mais fervoroso, mais incansável em seus esforços pelo domínio de si mesmo.

meta.face: A man of about seventy-five with a weathered, olive complexion and a LEAN, BONY, LONG RECTANGULAR face — a very high, lined forehead with two deep VERTICAL furrows between the brows, LARGE, luminous grey eyes under heavy lids, a long, straight nose ending in a BROAD tip, lean cheeks over strong cheekbones; bald crown with short curling grey hair at the sides; a LARGE, FULL, grey-white beard, broad and cut SQUARE across the bottom at mid-chest; the gaze deep and teaching, toward us.
meta.basis: No likeness from life. The Painter's Manual gives 'John Climacus, an old man with a large beard'; the Russian icon on Wikipedia shows a bald, long-bearded monk with a scroll. The ladder follows the Sinai icon of the Ladder of Divine Ascent (Wikipedia). The book tells his coming to Sinai at sixteen, his solitude, his abbacy at seventy-five and his book. The square-cut beard and furrowed long face are our choice.
